fixed.explanation: IntervalArray.__arrow_array__ calls pyarrow.from_numpy_dtype on a DatetimeTZDtype, which raises TypeError. ArrowIntervalType also serializes the subtype as a string like "timestamp[ns, tz=UTC]", which type_for_alias can't parse on deserialize. The edits build a pyarrow timestamp type with the tz, and serialize and deserialize the unit and tz explicitly.

input.intent: Interval extension array / ArrowIntervalType conversion to pyarrow: __arrow_array__ in IntervalArray and the ArrowIntervalType extension type, plus IntervalDtype.__from_arrow__ for restoring the dtype. Needs to handle tz-aware datetime subtype when building the pyarrow struct and restoring via parquet metadata.
input.symptom: Converting an Interval array with timezone-aware datetime bounds to pyarrow raises an error and does not round-trip through parquet to the same IntervalDtype.
